picks.title: 'Odyssey' translator Emily Wilson on her book of essays 'Crossing the Wine-Dark Sea'
picks.summary: Emily Wilson is a classicist whose translations of The Iliad and The Odyssey are popular and controversial. Recently, she was at the center of the discourse surrounding Christopher Nolan’s film adaptation of The Odyssey. Her new book of essays reflects on translation and the role of classics in modern society. In it, she argues that "it is a waste of everyone's time if a retranslation takes more or less the same approach as one or more existing published translations." In today’s episode, she speaks with NPR’s Joel Rose about Crossing the Wine-Dark Sea.Support public media with NPR+ and enjoy
picks.reason: Classicist discusses translation and cultural role of Homeric epics, engaging mythic literature.
